checks.name: Page data quality (JSON-LD, crawler fallback)
checks.fix: Add schema.org Product + Offer JSON-LD with name, image, brand, price, priceCurrency, availability.

checks.name: Catalog / endpoint access
checks.fix: Publish product URLs in sitemap.xml and expose a reachable UCP endpoint (Shopify does this automatically for eligible stores).

checks.name: Content completeness
evidence: https://bad.test/products/thing: missing ['title 1-150 chars', 'description >=150 chars', 'image', 'image alt text', 'brand', 'price', 'availability', 'GTIN or MPN']
checks.fix: Fill in: GTIN or MPN, availability, brand, description >=150 chars, image, image alt text, price, title 1-150 chars. OpenAI feeds require title, description, url, brand, seller, image, price, availability; GTIN/MPN strongly recommended.

checks.name: Policy clarity
checks.fix: Publish reachable returns (with window in days and cost), shipping, and contact pages; Google requires return window/cost/link and a support contact for agentic checkout.

checks.name: Agent access
evidence: robots.txt HTTP 200; shopping/search agents blocked on product page: ['OAI-SearchBot', 'ChatGPT-User', 'PerplexityBot', 'Claude-SearchBot', 'Claude-User']
checks.fix: Allow AI shopping agents in robots.txt and avoid bot challenges on product pages. Optional: publish /agents.md or /llms.txt.

checks.name: Checkout signals (UCP profile)
checks.fix: Publish a UCP profile at /.well-known/ucp (automatic on eligible Shopify stores; otherwise via Google's UCP integration).

checks.name: Checkout-ineligible flags (informational)
checks.fix: Google marks subscriptions, final-sale and pre-order items ineligible for agentic checkout; flag them in Merchant Center.
